## Milestone

Describe the agreed milestone and owner approval. Do not publish every local patch as a separate release.

## Changes

Summarize behavior, compatibility, and affected server/player components.

## Verification

- [ ] Node/Python tests (including agent integration), lint, typecheck, build
- [ ] Version/changelog consistency and repository hygiene checks
- [ ] Relevant desktop/mobile and hardware checks, or explicitly documented gaps
- [ ] Documentation and upgrade/rollback guidance updated
- [ ] No private media, configurations, credentials, or generated disk images

## Risks

Note migrations, deployment requirements, and remaining validation. Do not attach unredacted logs or databases.
